product.name: Lookbook Kit
product.description: An editable Canva lookbook at A4 landscape — cover, six spreads on one shared grid and a contact page, with the margins set and the backgrounds already bleeding past the trim — plus the plain-English RGB vs CMYK colour guide, the bleed and trim map, the photo prep sheet, a fill-in-the-blanks print-shop brief, the export checklist for the print and screen versions, and six spread layout recipes (Genius Junkie)
